"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now and not t.archived]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def remove_tasks(ids) -> int:
    """Remove all tasks whose id is in `ids`; return how many were removed."""
    ids = set(ids)
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id not in ids]
    removed = len(tasks) - len(remaining)
    if removed:
        save_all(remaining)
    return removed


def rename_task(task_id: int, new_title: str) -> bool:
    """Change a task's title; return False if no such task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.title = new_title
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Soft-delete a task: mark it archived and keep the record."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False


def clear_overdue(now: float | None = None) -> int:
    """Remove all overdue (non-archived) tasks; return how many were removed."""
    overdue_ids = {t.id for t in get_overdue_tasks(now)}
    if not overdue_ids:
        return 0
    tasks = load_all()
    save_all([t for t in tasks if t.id not in overdue_ids])
    return len(overdue_ids)
import argparse

from tinytasks.api import (
    clear_overdue,
    create_task,
    delete_task,
    get_overdue_tasks,
    remove_tasks,
    rename_task,
)
from tinytasks.text import normalize_title


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tinytasks")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add")
    p_add.add_argument("title")
    p_add.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    sub.add_parser("overdue")
    sub.add_parser("clear-overdue")

    p_quick = sub.add_parser("quick-add")
    p_quick.add_argument("title")

    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete")
    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)

    p_rm = sub.add_parser("rm")
    p_rm.add_argument("ids", type=int, nargs="+", metavar="ID")

    p_rename = sub.add_parser("rename")
    p_rename.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_rename.add_argument("new_title")

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "clear-overdue":
        print(clear_overdue())
    elif a.cmd == "quick-add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), 24 * 60 * 60)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "rm":
        print(f"removed {remove_tasks(a.ids)}")
    elif a.cmd == "rename":
        ok = rename_task(a.id, normalize_title(a.new_title))
        print("renamed" if ok else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Task model. due_at is a Unix timestamp in SECONDS (not milliseconds)."""

@dataclass
class Task:
    id: int
    title: str
    due_at: float  # unix timestamp, seconds
    archived: bool = False
import sys
import time

from tinytasks.api import archive_task, clear_overdue, create_task
from tinytasks.cli import main
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def test_clear_overdue_removes_and_counts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("late", -10)
    create_task("late2", -5)
    create_task("future", 10000)
    assert clear_overdue() == 2
    assert [t.title for t in load_all()] == ["future"]
    assert clear_overdue() == 0


def test_clear_overdue_keeps_archived(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("late", -10)
    archive_task(t.id)
    assert clear_overdue() == 0
    assert len(load_all()) == 1


def test_cli_clear_overdue_prints_count(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("late", -10)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "clear-overdue"])
    main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "1"


def test_cli_quick_add_due_in_24h(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    before = time.time()
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "quick-add", "  buy   milk "])
    main()
    (t,) = load_all()
    assert t.title == "buy milk"
    assert 86400 - 5 < t.due_at - before < 86400 + 5

import sys

from tinytasks.api import create_task
from tinytasks.cli import main
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def _run(monkeypatch, *args):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", *args])
    main()


def test_dedupe_keeps_earliest_due(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("a", 500)
    early = create_task("a", 100)
    create_task("a", 900)
    other = create_task("b", 300)
    _run(monkeypatch, "dedupe")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "removed 2"
    assert {t.id for t in load_all()} == {early.id, other.id}


def test_dedupe_is_exact_match_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("a", 1)
    create_task("A", 2)
    create_task("a ", 3)
    _run(monkeypatch, "dedupe")
    assert len(load_all()) == 3

    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    orig = create_task("write", 1000)
    _run(monkeypatch, "copy", str(orig.id))
    tasks = load_all()
    assert len(tasks) == 2
    assert tasks[1].title == "write (copy)"
    assert tasks[1].due_at == orig.due_at
    assert tasks[1].id != orig.id


def test_copy_missing(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    _run(monkeypatch, "copy", "99")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "no such task"
    assert load_all() == []
